summary: Fortuna Mining Corp. filed a Form 6-K announcing an earn-in agreement with Qstone Inc. to acquire up to a 70% interest in the Quartzstone Project in Guyana. No price per share or specific valuation is disclosed. The deal involves staged exploration expenditures totaling approximately US$5.5 million initially. No board recommendation or named advisor is cited. The structure is an earn-in, with Fortuna earning interest through exploration funding. Watch for regulatory approvals and exploration results to trigger subsequent earn-in milestones; no risk-arb spread as this is a private resource earn-in.
